transcript.text: Thank you all for reporting. Let me summarize the outstanding requirements before I issue my decision. Leon, the music license restricts streaming to the United States and Canada only — not worldwide — and requires a cue sheet to be delivered with the master. Maya, the archive-footage license caps the finished program at exactly 52 minutes, which means our current 68-minute assembly cannot be delivered under that license. Rafael, the artist's release requires written approval of the final picture before distribution, and the end-card credit must read exactly 'Featuring the Live Performance of Marisol Vega.' These are significant blockers. The streaming platform has requested a worldwide 68-minute master, but we cannot authorize worldwide delivery given the music license territorial restriction, and we cannot deliver at 68 minutes given the archive-footage runtime cap. I will now issue the formal settlement.
